sections.heading: Inner current loop
sections.text: Use per-switch peak-current sensing (one CT per primary switch). The current loop must be fast enough to prevent flux imbalance: f_ci ~ fsw/5. Add slope compensation with ramp >= V_out*N_pri/N_sec / (2*L_out*fsw) to prevent subharmonic oscillation at D approaching 0.5.

sections.heading: Outer voltage loop
sections.text: Effective output ripple frequency is 2*fsw, so the voltage loop can run at f_cv ~ 2*fsw/10 to 2*fsw/20. PI compensator. Start with kp = 2*pi*f_cv*C_out / (V_out * 0.01) and ki = kp * f_cv / 10.

sections.heading: Revision note
sections.text: If the push-pull shows rising magnetizing current (visible as asymmetric primary current), the flux-balance is broken. Verify: (1) current sensing is per-switch, not averaged, (2) slope compensation is equal on both phases, (3) the duty cycle stays below 0.5.
